items.title: Switzerland plans deportation of seriously injured Somali citizen
items.description: As we have learnt from two individuals affected, Swiss police authorities use an enormous amount of violence during forced deportations. From the perspective of lawyers and Swiss human rights organisations, the authorities are thereby committing massive violations of Swiss and international law. Furthermore, in at least two cases, they have put the lives of those affected at serious risk. Augenauf shares this assessment and has informed the relevant authorities (including the commander of the Zurich cantonal police and the National Commission for the Prevention of Torture, NKVF). Bot
items.titleIt: Switzerland plans deportation of seriously injured Somali citizen

items.title: Somali journalist Bashir Mohamed Abdullahi dies after being shot during Baidoa clashes
items.description: MOGADISHU, Somalia 7 September 2026 – The Somali Journalists Syndicate (SJS) expresses its deepest condolences over the death of journalist Bashir Mohamed Abdullahi, also known as Bashir Moalin, a reporter with the local Arlaadi Media Network, who succumbed to gunshot injuries sustained during armed clashes in Baidoa on Thursday, 3 September 2026. He becomes the second journalist killed in Somalia this year. Early on Monday, 7 September 2026, Bashir, 28, died from critical injuries he sustained while seeking shelter during armed clashes in Baidoa, Southwest State, his family told SJS. Accordin

items.title: Boy, 6, in coma after pool accident in Egypt being flown back to Italy - Tajani
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, SEP 3 - A six-year-old boy who has been in a coma in an Egyptian hospital since an August 3 accident at a swimming pool at Sharm El Sheikh is currently being flown back to Italy, Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani said on a visit to Cairo Thursday. The boy, Younes Majidi, who suffered a cardiac arrest and has been in critical condition since nearly drowning at the Red Sea resort, will be admitted for treatment at the Regina Margherita Children's Hospital in Turin, said Tajani, who is also deputy premier.
